rationale:
This is a full rebuild of the MBR builder across three screens (Reviews entry, data-pull collection, redesigned builder) with real state and persistence, not a restyle. The reasoning is genuinely fraught: several independent, easy-to-conflate invariants must all hold at once — delta-vs-last-MBR is always derived (never typed) and recomputes on manual edits, status is a human-owned editorial snapshot seeded at pull time and never auto-recomputed, "Carried" is pull-time provenance kept strictly separate from the status marker, and the month-only lock gate equals the completion meter (every KPI has a non-empty insight). The mockup-vs-brief tie-break rules (look wins vs behaviour wins, per-bucket lock affordances dropped) add scope-judgement risk. The seeded ADRs frame the architecture but the correctness reasoning and vertical-slice decomposition remain high, so research/validate/plan/planReview all warrant Opus.

Implementation is intricate and touches sensitive boundaries: a large CSS/class-vocabulary port into src/styles.css (checked by disk-reading contrast/token tests), DEV-only gating enforced by build-purity.test.ts, autosave/debounce, collection progress state, re-pull semantics that preserve manual values and insights, and reuse of the existing LockedView path for shared Preview/View rendering. Implement dominates both units: the plan likely decomposes into ~8–16 vertical slices, each running the adversarial Test-Writer + Implementer pair with retries against a broad co-located test suite, so request and token bands are wide. Verify stays Sonnet as a final check.
